observations: Neet has four traceable legs with feet on the stone, continuous narrow full torso and neck, large triangular ears and tiny nub; forward lean is supported and reads as overly serious inspection.

Buddy has a coherent resting ribcage/haunch, chin near forepaws and hind support on the cloth; no detached limbs or shortened trunk. Dark torso uses broad smooth shapes. Furnished ears, brows, moustache, distal regions and modest tail fringe are regional, not whole-body shag.

Food lies on the ground between the dogs; Buddy rests while Neet leans. Banyan, warm streetlamp, dark moonless sky and no humans match this narrative state. Clear visual contrast supports the setup joke.
Full-resolution finish is clean; broad light and shadow regions are not engraved coat strokes or raised shag contours.

Buddy, brown Chikki and gray greyhound remain spatially separate with owned limbs and grounded feet. Buddy retains continuous moderately elongated trunk, substantial legs, clearance, neck and low tapered tail.

The gray opponent reads as a greyhound: long narrow muzzle, small folded ears, deep narrow chest, tucked abdomen and fine long legs. It no longer reads as the broad-headed Great Dane from calibration.
Buddy has smooth close charcoal torso with regional face/ear/paw furnishing. Broad chest color shapes and sparse boundary tips do not establish uniform long coat or curling strands.
Food stays behind Buddy/Chikki, and their firm stance versus the hesitant greyhound carries the refused-entry gag. No misplaced Neet or humans; night banyan/streetlamp setting remains coherent.

Actual replacement opened at native 1448 x 1086 resolution and the entire image reinspected, not just the edited prop. Compared with earlier accepted stash image and already opened original N19/N29/B04/B29 photographs.
Food continuity is resolved: prominent pale cheese-like block with small holes and round brown pieces on cloth now agree with setup and defense. Bone biscuits and irregular kibble are absent.
Neet retains continuous full narrow torso, fine legs, four supported paws on the stone, broad triangular ears, projecting muzzle and tiny nub. No disconnected limbs or new support fault.

Buddy retains continuous moderately elongated charcoal torso, neck bending toward food, substantial legs and four owned grounded paws. Shadow retains coherent seated forelegs and folded hindquarters. Overlapping tails and bodies remain legible.

Smooth fawn and charcoal body shapes remain intact without curled, engraved coat strands or raised shag contours. Buddy furnishings remain confined to muzzle, brows, ears, distal regions and modest tail fringe; paper-like grain does not create coat volume.

Night banyan, streetlamp, command stone and foreground cloth persist. Buddy checking food, seated Shadow and watchful Neet match the stated aftermath before Heather appears. No human or scene regression; visual payoff now preserves the defended supplies.
